results.text: How does an idea get from a draft all the way to paper trading with real allocated capital?
results.answer:
Sir, an idea climbs a fixed staircase. A draft is only a question until you say yes; it is then registered, with the study written down before it runs. It is tested on 2000-2023 data only, at the strict pass mark, and a survivor then runs as a paper trial on live sessions, 20 recorded sessions in all.
It is admitted only after it beats both chance and the average stock on 10 separate sessions after costs, passes a check that no future data leaked in, and gets your yes. Only then may the allocated paper capital use it, and real money needs one more gate, the India final gate, with your yes again.
So far no rule has been admitted, and one draft is waiting for your yes or skip.
One thing that isn't right, sir: india evening, Zerodha part ran with an error at 13 Nov 20:00 Toronto. Ask me what's wrong for the details.
